title: Symmetry Breaking Lab
tagline: See why a width-four hidden layer can remain an effective width-one model
summary: A deterministic balanced-XOR experiment for comparing identical, slightly perturbed, and independent hidden-neuron initializations. Watch exact gradient descent preserve equality, inspect the four ReLU hinges, and track BCE, accuracy, parameter separation, and hidden-feature rank.
highlights: Train the same 2 → 4 ReLU → 1 architecture from identical, slightly perturbed, or independent parameters.
Separate parameter arrays verify that equality persists because gradients match, not because weights are shared.
Decision-surface and hinge canvases connect hidden-feature rank to the XOR regions the model can represent.
Live BCE, accuracy, neuron separation, and activation-matrix rank expose nominal width versus effective width.
